high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of a video description page from the Steve Jobs Archive. The video appears to be titled "Pixar's Early Days - A Never-Before-Seen Interview With Steve Jobs, 1996." The timestamp at the top indicates it was recorded on November 22, 1996, exactly one year after the film "Toy Story" debuted in theaters. Video Content: The video features an interview with Steve Jobs, discussing the challenges of finding talent and the financial constraints faced by Pixar.
